title: 7.3 My Clothes
unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
goal: Name clothes, describe their colors and identify whose clothes they are.
grammar_function: Name clothes, identify colors and describe the clothing of an explicitly established owner.
prerequisite: 2.8 colors; 2.3 this; 2.10 these; 1.3 is and are.
speaking_outcome: Name clothes, describe their colors and identify whose clothes they are.
